svg.title: OPAL operator run screen — annotated wireframe
svg.desc: Wireframe of the operator run screen with seven numbered design decisions: run context, scan-ID stepper, progress count, lane selector, one primary action, optional reference photo, and Complete Run disabled until the scans are done.
svg.text: Select a scan below, then tap Start Scan.
No reference photo saved for this run yet.
Background, material, shape, size and run
type come from the planner, so nothing is
− / + instead of typing the ID; a
continuity check flags gaps and repeats.
“0 / 5 scans” shows where the operator is
One tap selects a lane; each lane shows its
Full width, and named with the lane it will
Prep details collapse; the reference photo
is one tap, not a requirement.
Complete Run stays disabled until the scans
